shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && ls -R .agents | head -50 && cat AGENTS.md && ls -la && git ls-files

cat package.json src/*.tsx index.html tsconfig.json; ls __agent_eval__; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui; head -60 .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; rg -n -i "landing|page-constructor" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -30
sed -n 404,424p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs | head -40; npm view @gravity-ui/page-constructor version peerDependencies 2>&1 | tail -30

npm install @gravity-ui/page-constructor @diplodoc/transform 2>&1 | tail -15 && .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh page-constructor PageConstructor PageConstructorProvider HeaderBlock CardLayoutBlock BasicCard BannerBlock
git diff package.json; bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh page-constructor PageConstructor PageConstructorProvider HeaderBlock CardLayoutBlock BasicCard BannerBlock
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor && cat build/docs/INDEX.md | head -80; rg -n -C 3 -i "required setup|styles.css|PageConstructorProvider" README.md | head -60
sed -n 80,200p build/docs/INDEX.md; rg -n -C 6 -i "vite|sass" README.md | head -60

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/docs && wc -l blocks/Header.md blocks/ExtendedFeatures.md blocks/Banner.md blocks/CardLayout.md sub-blocks/BasicCard.md; cat blocks/Header.md | head -150
sed -n 1,74p blocks/ExtendedFeatures.md; sed -n 1,59p blocks/Banner.md

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor && rg -n -C 2 "animated|theme\?:" README.md | head -40; ls build/esm/blocks/Banner build/esm/sub-blocks/BannerCard 2>/dev/null; cat build/esm/sub-blocks/BannerCard/BannerCard.js 2>/dev/null | head -40; rg -n "animated" build/esm/models/constructor-items/common.d.ts build/esm/containers/PageConstructor/PageConstructor.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head

rg -n "animated" build/esm/components/AnimateBlock/AnimateBlock.js build/esm/containers/PageConstructor/*.js build/esm/blocks/ExtendedFeatures/ExtendedFeatures.js build/esm/blocks/Header/Header.js | head; rg -n "export|theme" build/esm/containers/PageConstructor/Provider.d.ts | head -30; cat /home/sandbox/workspace/vite.config.ts

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && rg -n "^#|ThemeProvider|brand|background" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | head -50; rg -n "isAnimationEnabled =" node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm -r '' | head -3; npm install -D sass vite-plugin-dynamic-import 2>&1 | tail -3

rg -n "useThemeType|export declare function useTheme\b" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/*.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/index.d.ts | head; sed -n 1,25p node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/containers/PageConstructor/Provider.d.ts; rg -n "^export (type|declare)" node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/models/common.d.ts | rg -i "theme" ; rg -n "PageContent\b" node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/models/*.d.ts | head -3

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/models && sed -n 1,8p common.d.ts; sed -n 1,25p constructor.d.ts; rg -n "HeaderBlock = |ExtendedFeaturesBlock = |BannerBlock = |interface HeaderBlockModel|interface ExtendedFeaturesBlockModel|interface BannerBlockModel" -r '' constructor-items/*.d.ts | head; rg -n "isAnimationEnabled|disableCompress" ../context/projectSettingsContext/*.d.ts

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/models/constructor-items && sed -n 1,30p blocks.d.ts; rg -n "^export (type|interface) (HeaderBlockModel|ExtendedFeaturesBlockModel|BannerBlockModel)" blocks.d.ts; rg -n "^export \* from|^export \{" ../../index.d.ts ../index.d.ts | head
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm && rg -n "models|grid" index.d.ts; sed -n 486,520p models/constructor-items/blocks.d.ts
head -20 node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/utils/url.js; rg -n "url" -i node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/package.json | head
ls node_modules/url 2>&1 | head -3; rg -n "parse\(|format\(" node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/utils/url.js
npm run build 2>&1 | grep -iE "warn|error|externalized|unable" | head; git status --short
cat .gitignore; rm -rf dist
